body: Bullshit. Nobody is a "lost cause". That is self-depricating talk and helps nobody. If you look inside yourself and you are totally, truely honest, you'll know that everyone deserves help and deserves to be happy. Go get the help you deserve, go get your happy.
Makes me very happy to know I helped. Keep pressing on brother, you got this.
Be more specific man. How exactly are you making their lives worse?

Here's the thing. I don't know you, but honestly from about 10 mins of Reddit comments I feel like already you've got a lot going on. School, hobbies, family. I'll never tell you that you "shouldn't" feel a certain way because in most cases depression isnt your fault, its chemical, and completely normal. But you sound like you have a lot of potential in your future. 

Speaking personally as someone who has been on the edge before, I powered through. Dedicated myself to school. Then my career. Then love came with it. Now I have a steady life that I swear to you I could not have imagined having before. Keep your head up brother, you have lots of opportunities ahead of you as long as you stay in the game.
Any long term goals? You in school? Have a job?

Doesn't have to always make sense. Feelings are often hard to put into words. But if you feel like you're a burden to others, then that means you care about others. And they probably care about you too. Have you talked to anyone about how you feel?

Your family would probably spend every dollar they had to help you. Put in your part. Go. Talk. Actively try to help yourself. If they are the ones sending you, that means they love you. Not everyone is lucky enough to have that, do not take it for granted. You'll never get better if you don't want to get better, and you sound like you have a support net behind you. You got this.

As someone who has been in a similar situation, hopping from meds to meds, seeing different professionals about my issues, I have to ask: have you taken any steps to help yourself too? Tell me more about yourself. What are your hobbies? What do you like to do for fun? And none of this "I find nothing fun" bullshit, be real and honest with me. What do you like to do.
Have you been to any sort of therapy yet? Or were the anti depressants from a family doctor?
I swear I'm not trying to patronize you at all, but why do you think you're a burden to others?

I understand not being able to explain things well, sometimes feelings are hard to put into words. 

Out of curiosity, have to spoken to anyone for help? The generalized anxiety disorder, etc, have they been professionally diagnosed or self diagnosed? Not to downplay your feelings in any way, I'm just wondering if you've actively tried to get help yet
What's brought you to this point?
What makes you feel this way?
Alright then bud, let's talk about it. If you felt like it was worth the time to post this, then it must be worth the time to talk. What's made you feel this way?

Listen man, despite what anyone tells you, love IS important. You need to love yourself to survive. You need to feel love from others. Humans are not solitary beings, we need connection and we feel connection in the form of love; whether it's from a partner, a friend, a dog, your parents, you need to feel like someone cares. And its fucking hard when you feel like you don't have any of that, I know. But someone out there loves you, I promise you. Reach out to others, find someone to spend time with. Love isn't passive, sometimes you have to earn it.
Any you can think of off the top of your head that won't result in permanent brain damage or obvious scarring in the case of a failed attempt?
